summary: A challenger never commits to a debate date and the incumbent answers the questions alone beside an empty chair.
realLife: A city council incumbent debated an empty chair after his challenger would not set a date, questioning what would be asked; the debate was recorded and shared on local TV, radio and video.
inGame: debate-invited record with no acceptance; the sponsor's rule on an empty chair

turns.turn: Both come and the race gets a real debate
turns.writesBack: a sitting and a news story on the answers
